import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("/inputs/providers.py")
content = p.read_text()
old = "model calls are off; set SKILLC_ALLOW_MODEL_CALLS=1 for a deliberate run"
new = "model calls are disabled; opt in explicitly before running a model"
assert content.count(old) == 1
new_content = content.replace(old, new)

    p.write_text(new_content)
    print("WRITE SUCCEEDED")
except Exception as e:
    print("WRITE FAILED:", type(e).__name__, e)
